subject: Interactive workshop: calendar shift & sample payload checklist
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Sara Bloom <sara.bloom@cloudscale.com>, Tom Evans <tom.evans@cloudscale.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Interactive workshop: calendar shift & sample payload checklist

Hi Sara / Tom —

Quick note as we finalize the agenda for next week's interactive lab: we need to confirm two things before we lock the calendar for the POC workshop.

1) Calendar window: initial invite was for Nov 17 10:00–14:00 PT. Could you confirm if you prefer shifting to Nov 18 the same time, or sticking with the 17th? We can also split into two 2-hour blocks if your team prefers a shorter, hands-on segment plus a follow-up review.

2) Sample payloads: please upload a small sample set (max 200 records) to the shared Drive folder listed below. We need: representative prompts, anonymized user text, and 5-10 edge-case inputs for routing/load testing. See attached redaction guidelines for PII removal. If you already have a sanitized CSV, drop that in with the prefix CS_samples_

Attachments: redaction-guidelines.docx, sample-prompts.csv, load-test-plan.md
Shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-shared-samples

Action items for your team: confirm preferred date (Nov 17 or Nov 18), and upload the sample files by EOD Nov 12 so we can run a pre-work verification pass.

We (Dev + Marissa) will prepare prompt templates and a small routing matrix for the hands-on exercises. Rishi will coordinate load windows and backend resource allocation.

Thanks — looking forward to this.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0127
From: Sara Bloom <sara.bloom@cloudscale.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Evans <tom.evans@cloudscale.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Interactive workshop: calendar shift & sample payload checklist

Thanks Kimberly — good checklist. Quick replies: 

• Date: Nov 18 works better for us (several on the infra team are out on the 17th). Can you move the invite to Nov 18 10:00–14:00 PT? If splitting helps you run more focused exercises, we prefer a single block to keep everyone engaged.

• Sample payloads: we can provide a sanitized subset but need clarification on redaction specifics. Our data has internal account IDs that are safe to keep as hashed values, but there are several free-text fields with potential PII. Can your redaction guidelines confirm whether email addresses must be fully removed vs. tokenized?

I'll coordinate the upload; expect the first batch by end of day Thursday (Nov 12). If we need more time, we'll flag it by Wednesday.

Thanks — Sara
Sara Bloom
Solutions Architect | CloudScale Inc.
Sara.Bloom@cloudscale.com | +1 617-555-0841

Subject: Re: Interactive workshop: calendar shift & sample payload checklist

Hi Sara —

Short answers on redaction: our quick rule-of-thumb is: remove direct identifiers (full email addresses, phone numbers, SSNs) or replace with consistent tokens (e.g., <EMAIL_1>, <PHONE_1>). Account IDs are fine to keep as hashed strings — that helps routing tests. We included a one-page quick guide in redaction-guidelines.docx; the doc also has a small regex you can run locally to catch common patterns.

I'll move the invite to Nov 18 10:00–14:00 PT and send an updated calendar link. If you decide later you need two shorter sessions, say the word and we'll split it.

Pre-work verification: once files are uploaded, can someone on your side ping me so Dev and I can run a quick sanity check? We usually do a 30-minute verification window where we validate format, a few sample prompts, and run a tiny local routing/latency test.

—Kimberly

Heads-up team —

I've reserved a pre-work verification slot on Nov 13 09:00–09:30 PT for the uploaded samples. During that window we'll run: a) schema check, b) basic routing pass against the prompts, c) a short load-target smoke test (50 concurrent simulated requests). If CloudScale can upload by EOD Nov 12 we should be good.

Also adding a note: for the smoke test please point them to the tokenized endpoint we'll provide (we'll share ephemeral API keys in the Drive folder). Dev, can you add the load-test snippets to load-test-plan.md and drop it in the folder? Marissa — please prepare the prompt templates for the lab (canonical prompt + two variants).

—Rishi
